NewsArticle.Title: Pet Dog Auction
NewsArticle.Content: , 2 p.m. PDT An envoy of the king will come to the fair market and display the pet dog. He will take bids in gold. He will take bids in items, too, if there is a fair merchant to appraise their value. Please be quiet during the bidding, except to state or increase your bid. If too many bids are spoken at once, none of them will be distinguished. Persons disrupting the bidding will be immediately banished from the Fair and Mileth.
